# Portal Citation Index (AUTO-GENERATED)

Generated by build_scripts/citation_index.py from the live portal pages.
NOTE: the script writes citation_index.json ONLY. This markdown file is NOT regenerated by it
and must be refreshed by hand from the JSON until the script is fixed. Regenerate the JSON after
any content change: `python3 build_scripts/citation_index.py` (it writes citation_index.json to the
repo root, but manual_diff.py reads it from build_scripts/, so copy it across).

## Untagged pages (manual content but NO parseable section refs - manual review required)

- **view**: mentions ['QRH'] - NO structured refs
- **fom_quiz / fom_q/*.json**: 452 FOM questions, each with a `ref` and `src.ref`, but the
  parser does not read them, so the FOM quiz bank is invisible to this index. Swept by hand.
- **cdu_preflight**: declares FCOM NP.21 only, but carries FOM-derived ETOPS facts (410 NM EEP
  ring, FOM 6.2.3 / 6.3.3). Not traceable by section.

## Known parser defects (found 2026-07-31)

- Only one direction is matched by manual_diff.py: a page citing FOM 5.6.6 is NOT flagged when
  5.6.6.3 changes. Match both directions when sweeping a revision.
- The manuals blurb in podcast.html is parsed as if the revision number were a section number
  (produced a bogus `124.2` key, now a bogus `125` key). Ignore FOM keys that are revision numbers.
